CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   B. Apply the teaching of Accounts of Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Accounts of Creation.
   D. Say Accounts of Creation has no place in daily life.

   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
